Inground Pool Openings

Pool Opening Packages

Check out our inground pool opening packages and conveniently book your own pool closing directly on our website.

Top Choice

Inground Pool Opening WITH Safety Cover

$400+hst
1. Remove Cover, Fold & Place In Customer Storage Bag
2. Lower Pool Water Level If Required
3. Remove Winterize Plugs From Returns & Skimmer
4. Re-Install return eyeballs, & drain covers if required
5. Re-Install ladders, handrails if required
6. Prime and start up pool equipment
7. Provide an Initial Chlorine Shock, PH & Alkalinity Chemical Treatment 
  • We do not re-install diving boards or pool slides
  • Removed equipment or covers will be left near the pool for you to store away
  • All fittings and small equipment pieces will be stored near the mechanical pad or in the pump strainer basket
If your inground swimming pool is already equipped with a winter safety cover this package is for you!
Book Now
